_doc: SC-010 query set (spec 115): people type their dialect, or the dialect and the language together, when asked for their language. `resolved` queries must list the right language first with the dialect or region attached; `unresolved` queries must list the right language first with the remainder chooser offered. ADD MISSES AUTHORS REPORT HERE: one row per query, with the language the author meant and what they meant by the extra words; the test in typedDialect.test.ts reads every row.
